_meta.description: Per-day growth parameters for the Traditional bonsai. Anchors (isAnchor:true) carry hand-tuned values; in-between rows are linearly interpolated between bracketing anchors. Round 1 covers a 13-anchor calibration set — densify days 1-30 in round 2 once the look is locked.

trunkHeight.note: normalized; multiply by ~300px for source-space trunk length above pot

trunkThickness.note: normalized; multiply by ~44px for source-space base width

leafSaturation.note: color richness — drops slightly in winter/late stages

barkTexture.note: gnarl/age cues — knuckle ellipses at trunk bends

mossOnTrunk.note: opacity + patch-count of moss climbing the trunk base

exposedRoots.note: opacity + count of root tendrils visible above soil

_meta.interpolation: linear between bracketing anchors; engineer may swap to smoothstep or curve-fit per param without schema change.
notes: Days 0–7 are the highest-engagement window — every day is an anchor.
Days 8–30 step every 3 days in round 1; densify to every 1–2 days in round 2.
Past day 365, hold the parameters; gain character through the catalog of detail overlays (lichen, weather marks) in code.
